runs.plain_english: Tony's newly printed Subtraction Within 20 student scan reproduced the live failure. The app found the sheet and answer boxes, but thin pencil 2s and 7s were often read as 1s or 9s, producing a valid answer score of 5/10. Do not push OCR changes until a candidate improves this without weakening the benchmark set.
